title: Parts & Service applies no product-type filter
permissions_required: Sales By Customer report View permission.
preconditions: 1. You are on the Sales By Customer report with both S and P invoices in the date range.
steps: 1. Set Product Type to "Parts only" and note the visible customers/totals.
2. Set Product Type back to "Parts & Service."
expected: 1. With "Parts & Service" selected, no product-type filter is applied — both S and P invoices are included again and counts/totals cover both.
